chunks: God wishes to make it clear to you and guide you through the example of earlier people, and to forgive you, for God is all-knowing and all-wise.

key_terms.يَتُوبَ: He causes to repent / He forgives

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for God to guide us through the 'sunnah' of those before us?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine concession to human nature, where Allah clarifies the 'sunan' (practices) of previous prophets to provide a familiar framework for the new Sharia, thereby facilitating acceptance and guidance. It underscores the merciful aspect of revelation, showing that divine law accommodates human capacity while maintaining the ultimate wisdom and knowledge of the All-Knowing. This context highlights the continuity of prophetic tradition and the pedagogical wisdom behind legislative clarity.
